title: Crispy Canadian Corn Bake
description: A simple and delicious side dish that combines the crunch of crispy corn with the warmth of baked Canadian bacon.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the Canadian bacon over medium heat until crispy, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked bacon, corn kernels, breadcrumbs, melted butter, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg and milk.
Add the egg mixture to the corn mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top of the corn mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
